title: slot map
description: Written by the builder to <world>/kantobridge/slot_map.json. Gives every (atlas, palette, tile, shape) the export uses a tile block: family f of that shape (kantobridge:tile_<shape>_<ff>) and slot s (block state hi = s >> 4, lo = s & 15). Derived from the whole export, never from a build's map filter, and authoritative in multiplayer. Entries are sorted by atlas, palette, tile, shape (version 2: by region first). Version 2 (MULTI_GAME_PLAN §4.6, MG3): one map per world shared by every region; `regions` gives each region its art set and its family range, and every entry names its region; families run 0..111 (MG7: 96 per shape, a Gen 3 region takes 80, GEN3_BRIDGE_PLAN §10 E7; MG9: 112, a Gen 2 region takes 16, GEN2_BRIDGE_PLAN §11 J7). A region's WorldIndex `slotMapHash` is the SHA-256 of the canonical version-1 form of that region's entries alone (its slice), so a rebuild of one region never changes another's hash; the legacy region at families 0..15 keeps today's hash exactly.

atlas.description: The export image id of the tileset atlas.

palette.description: The SGB palette the tile is coloured with.

region.description: Version 2 only: the region whose export this key comes from.

set.description: The art set the region's keys are drawn with (its game's export).

regions.description: Version 2 only: the regions sharing this map.
